name: llmquant-skills
description: Finance research, trading, risk, and portfolio Agent Skills grounded in LLMQuant Data.

interface.shortDescription: Finance Agent Skills powered by LLMQuant Data.
interface.longDescription: LLMQuant Skills provides category-level Agent Skills for equities, ETFs, options, commodities, crypto, prediction markets, macro, credit, rates/FX, events, portfolio, risk, strategy, and investor-lens workflows. Each skill routes to repeatable workflows and keeps external evidence grounded in LLMQuant Data.
defaultPrompt: Use llmquant-equities to build a five-lens stock analysis.
Use llmquant-options to evaluate IV rank and strategy choices.
Use llmquant-crypto to diagnose the current crypto market regime.
Use llmquant-macro to map macro data into portfolio impact.
